stage.value: Not a user journey stage; kit navigation

job.value: Find a web page and see whether it has had a fidelity pass

arrivedFrom.value: The 'Directory' item under Web pages in the kit sidebar

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Web pages' split into 'Ready (13)' and 'Work in progress (23)' says what the page is and how it's organised.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The grid of page cards ('Cart', 'Homepage', 'Listing (LDP)') is the whole content and each card is clearly the thing to click.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: Each card is named for the page it opens and tagged 'Ready' or 'WIP'.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Ready' and 'WIP' are explained by the section headings above them.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The only choice is which page to open.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Cards show just a name and status; detail lives on each page.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything is page cards and status, nothing else.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Card names and status pills carry it; there is no explanatory copy.
